directoryStems.mcq-dac12cb3fa30972172b47803: בת 85, עצמאית ב- BADL וללא חסר קוגניטיבי. ברקע אוסטאופורוזיס, מטופלת בויטמין D ו- ALENDRONATE. בנוסף, יתר לחץ דם שעד כה טופל עם דיאטה ופעילות גופנית, ללא טיפול תרופתי. בחודשים האחרונים מדידות חוזרות של לחצי דם סביב 165/90. מהי הגישה הטיפולית המתאימה בחולה זו?
directoryStems.mcq-df48fe04a1ef99cf9c29ad6c: A man whose hypertension remains uncontrolled on hydrochlorothiazide is considering chlorthalidone. Which pharmacologic difference is relevant?

directoryStems.mcq-786ac9a75006abf8f9b7827e: An 81-year-old ambulatory woman has uncontrolled hypertension and needs a treatment adjustment. Which principle should guide initiation and dose titration in older adults according to Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-97a974f43e5ad78c18eb2cba: A 76-year-old woman treated for hypertension reports dizziness on standing. Which measurement principle is important before changing treatment?
directoryStems.mcq-e7b19e4e91bcb638b7e68eac: A 78-year-old man with diabetes and chronic kidney disease is having his hypertension treatment reviewed. How should the treatment goal be set according to Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-700a54841a0c7944134254e9: An 81-year-old woman attends a routine visit without acute symptoms or evidence of acute target-organ injury. A single blood pressure measurement after walking to the clinic is higher than usual. What should be done before diagnosing sustained hypertension and changing treatment?
directoryStems.mcq-4f598f91d8b03b18446ff9d5: An older man with hypertension and a previous myocardial infarction is being considered for a beta-blocker. Which consideration supports its use according to Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-8c9797591f63ff3d23bc45b1: An 85-year-old nursing-home resident with advanced Parkinson disease, dysphagia, recurrent aspiration pneumonia, and complete dependence for daily activities has persistently elevated blood pressure. His representative asks about treatment. Before selecting a drug, which approach follows Hazzard for a person with high comorbidity burden and limited life expectancy?
directoryStems.mcq-56614f391c04935bca4dd3b1: A 76-year-old woman with hypertension and mild frailty walks with a walker and covers 5.2 meters in 8 seconds. Her baseline blood pressure is 148/82 on amlodipine 5 mg daily. In a trial she is assigned to an intensive systolic blood pressure target below 120 mm Hg. After amlodipine titration and addition of lisinopril, her blood pressure is 118/68 seated and 114/66 standing. She feels well and reports more energy. Which interpretation of the SPRINT evidence supports continuing her tolerated regimen with monitoring?
directoryStems.mcq-2a07ceac01397e535007d327: Chlorthalidone is being considered for hypertension in an older patient. How does Hazzard describe it in comparison with hydrochlorothiazide?
directoryStems.mcq-7d65ccd729c0f8ac8a37e020: A 73-year-old woman with hypertension takes a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug for joint pain. What is the role of reviewing this medication in her blood pressure evaluation?
directoryStems.mcq-d7947f0b3a41155a5df4df97: A 78-year-old man has recovered from pneumonia. Repeated clinic and home blood pressure readings are around 170/90 mm Hg, without orthostatic hypotension. He has untreated stage 2 hypertension and no coronary disease or heart failure. Combination treatment is planned. Which two drug classes should be started at low doses and titrated gradually in this patient?
directoryStems.mcq-bd220ca7ca24b1b0156ceadf: An 82-year-old woman with dementia sometimes refuses tablets. After the team adjusts medication administration, she willingly accepts oral treatment. Persistent hypertension requires treatment; a thiazide previously caused hyponatremia, and there is no cardiac indication for a beta-blocker. Renal function and potassium are normal. Which class is the most appropriate initial choice among these options according to Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-587a66507712957a38af1bdc: A 75-year-old man with hypertension, prediabetes, and BPH takes chlorthalidone 25 mg daily and tamsulosin 0.4 mg daily. His blood pressure is 146/84. He reports dizziness on standing quickly and nocturia four to five times nightly that disrupts sleep. Glucose is 118, potassium 3.4, and creatinine 1.1. When reviewing possible thiazide adverse effects, which strategy follows the principles described in Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-851f55361fb5e14b5ab96c89: A 77-year-old woman presents after a fall and reports a month of dizziness on standing. She takes amlodipine 10 mg, hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg, and lisinopril 20 mg each morning. Blood pressure is 138/78 supine and 108/68 after three minutes standing; pulse rises from 68 to 74. Potassium is 3.3 and creatinine 1.2. During medication review, which option both removes the thiazide exposure associated with potassium loss and provides potassium replacement?
directoryStems.mcq-81f6b10f34574870d54e9243: A 79-year-old woman with hypertension has maintained blood pressure below her individual target on stable treatment after successful lifestyle changes. Which approach to reducing treatment does Hazzard describe?
directoryStems.mcq-816a79a1791517b190352ff2: A woman treated for hypertension develops hyponatremia and hypokalemia. Which drug class is linked to this pattern in Hazzard’s table of antihypertensive medications for older adults?
directoryStems.mcq-58097bd742d304c155cd4494: בן 76 הסובל מיתר לחץ דם. מה הטיפול התרופתי המתאים על פי הרקע הרפואי שלו?
directoryStems.mcq-7faf3ea2990c59570295210c: על פי המאמר Time to Clinical Benefit of Intensive Blood Pressure Lowering in Patients 60 Years and Older With Hypertension מאת Chen וחבריו ב- JAMA 2022 מה ההשפעה של איזון אגרסיבי של לחץ הדם על MACE- Major adverse cardiovascular events?
directoryStems.mcq-ba95508abaa2e8c6c5b63ba6: בת 75, עצמאית ב- BADL וללא חסר קוגניטיבי. ברקע אוסטאופורוזיס, מטופלת בוויטמין D ו- ALENDRONATE. בנוסף יתר לחץ דם, שבחצי שנה האחרונה טופל עם דיאטה ופעילות גופנית, ללא טיפול תרופתי. בשבועות האחרונים מספר מדידות של לחץ דם סביב 165/90. מה הגישה הטיפולית הנכונה בחולה זו?

בת 85, בדרך כלל בריאה ולא נוטלת תרופות. הגיעה לבירור עקב מדידות חוזרות של לחץ דם סביב 150/110.
איזו מהבדיקות הבאות מומלצת כחלק מהבירור?

בת 68, עצמאית ושמורה קוגניטיבית, ללא מחלות רקע משמעותיות, אובחנה כסובלת מיתר לחץ דם עם ערכים סביב 135/85.

highlightAliases.old: For ambulatory community-living older adults, the cited guideline uses a systolic goal of 130 mm Hg; high comorbidity burden or limited life expectancy calls for patient-informed judgment (p1223).
highlightAliases.new: For ambulatory community-living older adults, p1223 summarizes the goal as 130 mm Hg. The 2017 guideline specifies below 130 if average systolic pressure is at least 130. Substantial comorbidity or limited life expectancy calls for individualized judgment.

highlightAliases.old: of BP result in excess of 130 mm Hg systolic and/or 80 mm Hg diastolic or those receiving an antihypertensive medication—the overall prevalence for hypertension among those aged 65 or older exceeds 65%.
highlightAliases.new: Based on this study’s updated definition of hypertension (discussed herein)—a self-report of BP result in excess of 130 mm Hg systolic and/or 80 mm Hg diastolic or those receiving an antihypertensive medication—the overall prevalence for hypertension among those aged 65 or older exceeds 65%.

highlightAliases.old: Their mechanism of action—decreased peripheral vascular resistance—and lack of significant central nervous system or metabolic side
highlightAliases.new: Their mechanism of action—decreased peripheral vascular resistance—and lack of significant central nervous system or metabolic side effects provide a good match with the characteristics of the geriatric patient.

highlightAliases.old: Hazzard reserves beta blockers for compelling indications, specifically secondary prevention after MI or in coronary artery disease.
highlightAliases.new: Hazzard reserves beta blockers for compelling indications, specifically secondary prevention after MI or coronary artery disease, or treatment in selected patients with systolic dysfunction.
